Since 0.1.16. The major version stays 0.

### Saves
Foldcade now tells you plainly where each game's save stands, and stops before a launch could lose one. **Saves synced** appears only when Foldcade has checked that the emulator really writes to the folder it watches and RomM has the save. A folder Foldcade can't check yet says so, for example **Save folder not checked yet** or **Can't read config**, rather than showing a check (#425).

When an emulator is saving somewhere other than the folder Foldcade watches, the game's tile and hero turn amber and R1 says so. Pressing A shows **Fix it** and **Play anyway**. Playing anyway is never device-only: what you play is kept on RomM as a Backup, and it never replaces the save you're playing from (#425).

**Fix it** repairs a wrong folder on its own when it can. It keeps every copy it finds on RomM first, waits for the game to close, switches to the right folder, and puts RomM's save back. Offline, it waits for RomM. If you've already quit the game, **Already quit?** asks before it continues, and it opens on **Not now**. When Foldcade can't fix it alone, the page walks you through it (#427, #431).

A save that comes back looking reset or brand new isn't uploaded as your progress. It's kept on RomM as a Backup, and Y › Saves offers both saves to choose from (#427).

Foldcade now checks the save setup of each emulator it supports:
- **Azahar:** catches Azahar moving to another folder (#425).
- **Eden:** follows a changed save folder or Eden user, and keeps the earlier saves (#430).
- **RetroArch:** warns when a game saves beside its ROM or a config points elsewhere (#428).
- **DuckStation:** checks which memory card it opens, names a different card, and keeps that card on RomM (#429).
- **melonDS, GBA.emu, GBC.emu, NES.emu, Snes9x EX+ and MD.emu:** catch saves written beside the ROM. In melonDS that setting covers every game, so every melonDS game waits until it's fixed. GBC.emu setup says to choose its folder again in GBC.emu first (#432).
- **ARMSX2:** reads its memory card folder, and explains how to set it back when it points outside ARMSX2's data folder (#433).
- **aPS3e and Dolphin:** check their own folders. After aPS3e is reinstalled, Foldcade says it lost access and helps you allow it again. Dolphin's per-game card settings are read, and Wii, RVZ and Slot B saves are shown as not synced (#436).

Where Android doesn't let Foldcade read an emulator's settings, Foldcade watches where the saves actually land.

### Resuming games
A paused Azahar game comes back where you left it, without starting again (#426). A game you quit inside Azahar, ARMSX2, Eden or melonDS no longer shows **Resume**: A starts it fresh, through the save check. One press of A now does one thing. For other emulators, if A opens the emulator's own menu, Foldcade says to come back and use Y › Restart (#434, #435).

### Updates
Foldcade checks GitHub for its own updates and every installed plugin's, about 30 seconds after it starts and every six hours. With **Update automatically** on in Settings › About, an update downloads in the background and installs only at a quiet moment, such as when no game is open and the screens have been off for a while. After an update, R1 says what changed, and **What's new** opens the release notes on the screen full pages use (#420, #423).

Foldcade now targets Android 15, so on Android 17 it updates itself without asking. Android still needs **Install unknown apps** allowed for Foldcade, and A on an **update ready** notice now opens that switch (#421, #422).

### Display
Foldcade's screens stay in landscape on the Thor after an unlock (#424).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
- On Android 17, Android's folder picker can't choose a folder under `Android/data`. Save sync for an emulator that keeps its saves there needs that emulator's data or save folder moved to shared storage first.
- If Android closes Azahar in the background to free memory, its tile can still say **Resume**. Android doesn't tell Foldcade. The next A restarts the game through the save check.
- ARMSX2's separate-card-per-game option is hidden from Foldcade, so games using it stay **Save folder not checked yet**.
- Foldcade doesn't yet tell PPSSPP which save folder to use. It checks where PPSSPP's saves land instead.
